text.title: 橱窗里的样品
text.situation:
前面的橱窗仍有些空。一家本地制造商借给米娜三块织物样品和两个成品包。努尔在旁边放了一小盘首饰。这些包作为日常用品推广销售，所以米娜把它们放在饭盒旁拍照，没有搭配华丽服装。一位有购买意向的顾客停在窗外，指着一个绿包。隔着玻璃，它看起来比实际小。米娜打开门，邀请她拿起来看看。后来，杰伊提出放大产品卡上的照片。米娜同意，但尺寸必须仍印在下面。大照片应让人看清缝线，不应让包显得比实际更大。

绿色日常用包
棉织物；可拆内袋。
尺寸：30×24 厘米。
价格从无内袋款的 18 英镑到带内袋款的 21 英镑。
想看样品，请到柜台询问。

paragraphs.en: The front window was still rather empty. A local manufacturer had lent Mina three textile samples and two finished bags. Beside them, Noor placed a small tray of jewellery. The bags were marketed as everyday items, so Mina photographed them beside a lunch box rather than a glamorous outfit. A prospective customer stopped outside and pointed to a green bag. Through the glass it looked smaller than it really was. Mina opened the door and invited her to hold it. Later, Jay offered to enlarge the photograph on the product card. Mina agreed, provided the dimensions stayed printed underneath. A bigger picture should make the stitching easier to see, without making the bag look bigger than it was.

paragraphs.en:
GREEN EVERYDAY BAG
Cotton textile; removable inner pocket.
Size: 30 × 24 cm.
Prices range from £18 for a plain bag to £21 for one with an inner pocket.
Ask at the counter to see the samples.

S08.Q03.P01.cue: 说说制造商、织物和包怎样推广销售。
acceptableAnswers: 制造商借给米娜三份样品。 包由一种棉织物制成。 这些包作为日常用品推广销售。

S08.Q03.P02.cue: 说说展示的首饰和包的价格。
acceptableAnswers: 努尔把首饰放进橱窗。 价格从十八到二十一英镑。

S08.Q03.P03.cue: 说说潜在顾客和照片的改动。
acceptableAnswers: 一位潜在顾客停在橱窗前。 杰伊放大卡片上的照片。

S08.Q03.T01.cue: 请别人把一张小照片放大，怎么说？
